target.statement: FID of 2.82 on LSUN Church for the proposed GLeaD method (StyleGAN2 + generator-leading task)

compute.basis: Training StyleGAN2 with GLeaD on LSUN Church requires 50M images shown to D, which took 55.78 hours on 8 A100 GPUs (per Table 7); on a single RTX 3060 this would take weeks, and the 3M image dataset plus checkpoints need hundreds of GB of disk.

blockers: No code or model weights released (no links in PDF, project page not linked in text)
Requires training StyleGAN2 from scratch on LSUN Church (3M images, 50M images shown to D)
Training time is 55.78 hours on 8 A100 GPUs, far beyond a few hours on a laptop
Needs GPU with large VRAM (StyleGAN2 at 256x256 typically requires >16GB VRAM for batch training)
Dataset download and preprocessing (LSUN Church) requires significant disk space and time
title: GLeaD: Improving GANs with A Generator-Leading Task
